precedence: System safety overrides all lower layers.
Entity identity errors override all content generation.
Version/time conflicts override SEO and title optimization.
Human veto can lock automatic publishing.
Optimization can never override a hard gate.
truth: A URL is not permanent evidence; preserve retrieval time and snapshot/hash.
A current claim cannot silently inherit an old state.
Truth records are versioned and auditable.
Official statements establish what the official said, not automatically objective truth.
Multiple reposts of one original source count as one independent evidence chain.
claims: Every material claim must have a Claim ID.
Every material claim must have evidence links.
Evidence scope must cover claim scope.
Claim strength cannot exceed evidence strength.
Prediction must be explicitly labeled as prediction.
Opinion must not be presented as fact.
Speculation must not be promoted to verified fact.
numbers: Every material number must carry value, unit, source, date, version, scope and method.
Percent and percentage points must not be confused.
Peak, average, cumulative and point-in-time values must not be conflated.
Old numeric results must be revalidated when source data changes.
causality: Causal claims require stronger evidence than observational claims.
Alternative explanations must be checked for major causal claims.
If causality is unsupported, language must be downgraded to observation.
recovery: Truth record changes trigger downstream content revalidation.
A corrected fact must propagate to dependent articles, scripts and posts.
Every correction must preserve the previous version and reason.
ai_firewall: Model memory cannot substitute for source evidence.
Missing fields remain UNKNOWN rather than being inferred as fact.
AI confidence cannot replace evidence quality.
The system must support ABSTAIN when evidence is insufficient.
